module.purpose: Implements the React Fiber host configuration for the Fabric renderer (React Native), bridging React's reconciler to the native Fabric UI manager for node creation, persistence, event priority mapping, and fragment ref support.
module.summary: This module is the Fabric-specific React reconciler host config for React Native. It exports the functions the reconciler calls to create, clone, append, and manage native shadow nodes and their public instances, and re-exports several no-op config modules. It defines a FragmentInstance pseudo-class that emulates DOM-like fragment refs by observing child host instances. It maps Fabric event priorities to React event priorities and provides lazy public instance creation. The file relies on globals from the native bridge and feature flags.
module.businessContext: Core React Native Fabric rendering infrastructure. Failure breaks all RN UI creation, updates, and fragment ref support.

detail.name: cloneInstance
preconditions: sourceInstance must be a valid fabric host instance with getStateByType method
additionalProps and overrideProps must be objects or null/undefined
postconditions: Returns a new fabric host instance with merged props from source, additional, and override layers
The returned instance shares the same internal state reference as the source instance
invariants: Override props take precedence over additional props, which take precedence over source instance props
The cloned instance maintains the same internalInstanceHandle identity as the source
edgeCases: When overrideProps is null/undefined, only additionalProps are merged
When both additionalProps and overrideProps are null/undefined, a clone with original props is returned
Properties in overrideProps that are null/undefined are still applied (not skipped)

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Throws TypeError if sourceInstance is not a valid fabric instance

detail.summary: Creates a shallow clone of a React Native Fabric host instance, merging additional and override props onto the source instance's props to produce a new instance with updated configuration.
